name: Boogiepop wa Warawanaku mo Nai
original_name: ブギーポップは笑わなくもない
source:
It is a dark parody on anime "Boogie-pop does not laugh". It features five different genres - battle simulation + adventure + sound novel + puzzle + mini game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
